{{Quote|Let's see, now, that wouldn't by any chance make you heir to the Kail Ranges, would it?|Han Solo to Torm Dadeferron|<ref name="Han Solo at Stars' End">''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]''</ref>}}
The '''Kail Ranges''' were large ranges found on the planet [[Kail]]. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the ranges were controlled by [[Dixon Dadeferron]] and his family. Dixon and his two sons, [[Trevim Dadeferron|Trevim]] and [[Torm Dadeferron|Torm]], were independent landowners under the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. After some sort of dispute over land-use rights and stock prices, Dixon and his eldest son, Trevim, spoke out against the Authority and failed to yield to its pressure. Shortly after, they were abducted and taken to the Authority [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility at [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]], leaving the younger son, Torm, in complete control of the ranges.
